answer: Hold every payout in a retroactive-clawback escrow for many epochs: an agent spends nothing until its reward ages, and if a jury later proves the identity sybil, all its banked earnings are clawed back and its bond slashed. A fake looks solid as ivory yet rests on shale; one later proof collapses the whole seam like a karst sinkhole. To net value from N clones an attacker must keep each one clean for the full window and still forfeits everything on detection, so expected cost scales as N times locked bond plus N times clawed accruals.
